title: The US troop surge, a year later
description: A year ago in Baghdad: Shiite militiamen and Sunni insurgents owned entire neighborhoods and key areas beyond. Iraq's government was adrift, and U.S. commanders weighed the real possibility of being trapped in a full-scale civil war.

title: U.S. Navy develops acceptable-use policy for IT equipment
description: The standardized policies are to go into effect in the first quarter of 2005 and will apply to the Navy's 900,000 military, contractor and civilian users.

title: No. 7 Pitt fends off Villanova
description: Levance Fields scored 20 points and Aaron Gray had 14 points and 10 rebounds, leading No. 7 Pittsburgh over Villanova, 65-59, last night in Philadelphia.

title: RSA: EMC addresses security in its Symmetrix storage arrays
description: EMC has added a tamper-proof view of management and support actions, safeguards against unauthorized service actions and certified data erasure to its high-end Symmetrix storage arrays.

title: Wyeth raises outlook, sees new blockbusters
description: Wyeth  on Thursday raised its 2006 profit forecast and said its recently approved Tygacil antibiotic and three experimental medicines all could post annual sales in the billions of dollars.

title: Microsoft Buys Stake in Facebook
description: The investment ends two months of jockeying among Microsoft, Google and Yahoo for the right to invest in and forge close ties with the fast-growing social networking Web site.

title: Bombing at Iraq Police Station Kills 20
description: KIRKUK, Iraq - A suicide attacker detonated a car bomb Saturday outside an Iraqi police academy as hundreds of trainees and civilians were leaving for the day, killing 20 people and wounding 36 others in the latest attack designed to thwart U.S-backed efforts to build a strong Iraqi security force ahead of January elections.    U.S and Iraqi forces, meanwhile, launched an operation in another northern town, Tal Afar, to flush out a militant cell allegedly smuggling men and arms in from Syria, sparking a fierce gunbattle that left at least eight people dead and more than 50 injured...

title: Microsoft, Amazon Take A Phishing Trip
description: Microsoft and Amazon.com are taking action against e-mail spammers and phishing scam perpetrators, but even two of the most powerful Internet companies on earth will find this fight to be tough going. -washingtonpost.com
